name: Golden Gardens & Ballard
boundaryDescription: Includes the western trail from Golden Gardens to Ballard and the separate 1.26 km reach starting at 11th Avenue NW toward Fremont (ownership-map section 02). Both existing reaches contribute to this area's count; the Ballard Missing Link gap between them is excluded.

name: Fremont & the canal
boundaryDescription: The canal-side corridor around Fremont has several ownership changes, including very short sections between longer stretches.

name: Wallingford & Northlake
boundaryDescription: The mapped trail follows the north side of Lake Union toward the University District. Short ownership changes appear at the eastern end of this reach.

name: University of Washington
boundaryDescription: The trail crosses the University of Washington area. Purple university sections alternate with short blue SDOT sections on the source map.

name: Ravenna & Bryant
boundaryDescription: North and east of the university, the source shows Parks stretches separated by short SDOT sections.

name: Sand Point corridor
boundaryDescription: The mapped route turns toward the western shore of Lake Washington. Longer Parks stretches alternate with small SDOT sections.

name: Matthews Beach corridor
boundaryDescription: The trail continues north along the Lake Washington corridor. Several small SDOT sections interrupt the Parks ownership shown in yellow.

name: North Seattle & map edge
boundaryDescription: The final mapped reaches continue north toward the edge of the Seattle map. Ownership beyond the supplied map is not included.
